name: PZL M-18 Dromader
summary: Large Polish single-seat ag plane, developed with Rockwell and sharing wing and fuselage parts with the Thrush Commander. Widely used for crop spraying and firefighting.

wings: Low cantilever wing with no struts
engines: Single large 1,000 hp nine-cylinder radial in a big round cowl
fuselage: Large hopper in front of a single-seat cockpit set high and aft
tail: Conventional tail with a tall fin and rudder

tellTales: Very large radial engine and big prop on a single-seat crop duster
Tall, aft-set cockpit behind a large hopper
Strut-free low wing on a heavy tailwheel airframe

confusedWith.howToTell: The Thrush shares parts but is smaller, with a smaller radial in many versions; the Dromader has the bigger ~1,000 hp radial and larger dimensions.
The Air Tractor has a taller cockpit and usually a turbine or smaller radial; the Dromader has a large round radial.
The Weatherly 620 is smaller with an R-985 radial; the Dromader is larger with a bigger radial.
